verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app with OAuth, so compatible AI assistants can connect to your files. It also ships an official Claude Code plugin that loads Poly memory and connects the MCP server, plus a poly-cli agent skill, and it advertises a plugin for Claude, ChatGPT and VS Code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs for the ChatGPT and VS Code plugins beyond the marketing mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect external LLMs and AI tools to my notes through first-party connectors or an ecosystem of AI plugins

citations.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets compatible AI assistants connect to Poly.
MCP clients can connect to `https://mcp.poly.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP). Authentication is OAuth
The official plugin loads your Poly memory when each session starts, teaches Claude how to use Poly, and connects the Poly MCP server.
Use our plugin with leading agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code and make your file workflows insanely fast.
teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing `poly` commands.
